hooks.command: IN=$(cat); [ "$(printf '%s' "$IN" | jq -r '.stop_hook_active // false')" = "true" ] && exit 0; R=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null) || exit 0; IDX="$R/dev-docs/INDEX.md"; [ -f "$IDX" ] || exit 0; M=""; for d in "$R"/dev-docs/*/; do [ -d "$d" ] || continue; b=$(basename "$d"); /usr/bin/grep -qaF "$b" "$IDX" || M="$M $b"; done; for d in "$R"/dev-docs/*/*/; do [ -d "$d" ] || continue; b=$(basename "$d"); case "$b" in repair-*|update-*|childtask-*) /usr/bin/grep -qaF "$b" "$IDX" || M="$M $b";; esac; done; [ -z "$M" ] && exit 0; printf '%s' "$M" | jq -Rs '{decision:"block",reason:("dev-docs/INDEX.md 未收录以下任务目录："+(.|ltrimstr(" ")|rtrimstr("\n"))+" —— 请按 INDEX §9 的 T1 追加条目（嵌套子目录用 ├/└ 挂在父任务行下方），并顺手重跑 §0.5 反查表命令，然后再结束本轮。")}'
